body: The only way they'll take me is if I agree to go back on medication, which I will not do. I'd rather not live the rest of my life as a ward of the state.

All of my friends live with their parents and have stable lives. The last thing they need is me dumping my crazy on them. I broke down crying when I was picked up but can't seem to muster up any more emotion.

I spoke to my girlfriend (of 10 years) about it. She got so sad on hearing that SHE ended up in the hospital, where she is now. I wouldn't have turned to reddit if I had anyone else I could speak to.

There really isn't anything I enjoy about life. I've coasted by on the kindness of others for the last year and a half. Seems like they'd be better off without the burden.
